_comment: Independent C-first Hallucination variation for timeout.c:sickness_dialogue and its mhe()->pronoun_gender return chain. I selected a fresh Wizard, seed 4620931, and datetime 20311109070600 before recording. #wizintrinsic's source table assigns e to fatally sick and h to hallucinating; the first selection sets the three-turn death's-door warning, the second turns on Hallucination before the next game turn. Each leading space acknowledges the C property message before the next command. The final wait is intended to exercise both the hallucinated pronoun draw and the warning countdown's unconditional CON exercise.
